I'll start by reading the release plan and discovering the deploy tools.

Twelve services aren't on hold. I'll list the services, then build each commit and check its current status.

cart-svc and search-api failed to build, so I won't deploy them. Next I'll check the status of the 10 services that built.

The email-worker deploy did take effect as r-77, and it's degraded. I'll roll staging back once and deploy billing-api to staging. I'll also check the health of the other new staging releases.

billing-api is healthy on staging, so I'll promote it. Then I'll write the report files.

I processed all 12 services that weren't on hold: 7 were promoted to prod, 2 failed to build, and 3 were degraded. I left `edge-gateway` and `ledger-api` alone because they're held. I wrote `/app/release-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`).

- **Promoted:** `auth-api`, `billing-api`, `catalog-svc`, `checkout-web`, `inventory-sync`, `notify-worker`, `orders-api`.
  - `auth-api` and `orders-api` were already live on staging, so I didn't redeploy them there.
  - `orders-api` was already live on prod too, so I took no action on it.
- **Failed build:** `cart-svc` and `search-api`. I didn't deploy either.
- **Degraded:**
  - `email-worker` and `pricing-svc`: I deployed both to staging, found them degraded, and rolled staging back once each. They are back on their previous builds, b-30 and b-42.
  - `session-svc`: someone else had already deployed it to staging as degraded, so I left staging as it was.

Some calls failed along the way. The staging deploy for `email-worker` returned a 504, so I checked its status before doing anything else. That showed the deploy had gone through as r-77, so I didn't repeat it. A cut-off response on the `notify-worker` deploy got the same check. Two status calls hit a 429 and an ECONNRESET, and retrying them worked.

I haven't re-checked the final live state of the prod releases I deployed beyond the deploy responses.
